fact: The National Land Authority presentation lists the establishment of a National Registry system (LAIS) with a spatial database, with more than 14 systems connected to LAIS.
The Ministry of Environment says that today every land record is kept in a digital registry, and that the e-Title system issues digital land titles.
The Ministry of Environment says the nationwide land tenure regularisation of 2009-2013 digitised parcels and that today every land record is kept in a digital registry.
The Ministry of Environment says land transactions that need no notary are now fully online via Irembo and e-Titles can be downloaded at landinformation.lands.rw.
The scorecard, as reported by KT Press, says the Land Administration Information System has been linked to IFMIS, the Rwanda Revenue Authority and Irembo, bringing 12 land services online.

House in Rwanda quotes a National Land Authority official saying Rwanda converted over 10 million paper land titles to digital format in 2023 and more than 866,000 electronic titles have been downloaded.
